Name: Orbyx: Mystic Orbs of Chaos
Overview: Orbyx is an amazingly addictive pachinko-style game. The goal is to collect all of the golden orbs in the 32 ingenious levels by blasting them with flaming-metal cannonballs. However, you must also summon incredible magic spells and make massive combos in order to get to the top of the scoreboard. It may be easy to start playing but it's impossible to stop!
